authorization: user requested document addition and risk-to-options mapping/priorities
status: proposed response inventory; no purchases or patient-specific prescriptions
priority_method: qualitative likelihood, shortage harm, urgency, effective treatment coverage, dependencies and overlap; prescription status does not lower priority

responses.prevention_recognition: Share caregiving and rest; recognize impaired function, hopelessness or escalating distress.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: Rest, support and counseling; clinician treatment for persistent illness. Sedatives are not a routine preparedness intervention.
responses.equipment_dependencies: Safe sleep space, lighting, paper contacts, communication and caregiver backup.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.prevention_recognition: Reduce carrying strain and fall hazards; assess severe headache, inability to bear weight or deformity.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: Acetaminophen; ibuprofen if appropriate. Rest/support for minor injury; reassess possible fracture.
responses.equipment_dependencies: Age-specific liquids, dosing devices, wrapped cold packs and simple supports; cause assessment.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.problem: Minor cuts, abrasions, blisters and splinters
responses.prevention_recognition: Gloves/footwear; inspect depth, retained debris, circulation and increasing redness.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: Clean, protect and reassess. Plain petrolatum for suitable minor wounds; complex contamination needs wound assessment.
responses.equipment_dependencies: Accessible safe cleaning water, soap, irrigation supplies, gloves and nonstick dressings; tetanus records.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.problem: Diaper rash, chafing and damaged skin
responses.prevention_recognition: Frequent diaper changes and drying; recognize spreading redness, blisters or fever.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: Plain petrolatum or zinc-oxide barrier; diagnosis-specific treatment for fungal/bacterial lesions.
responses.equipment_dependencies: Diapers, clean water, mild soap, drying materials and small clean topical containers.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.prevention_recognition: Maintain fluid/food/activity; severe pain, vomiting, distension or bleeding need another diagnosis.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: PEG 3350 for appropriate constipation; other agents selected by cause. Adult famotidine is an optional acid-symptom choice.
responses.equipment_dependencies: Safe mixing liquid, food/fiber, toilet access; child-specific selection and prescription-interaction check.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.prevention_recognition: Hygiene and reduced sick contact; recognize breathing difficulty, poor feeding and infant fever.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: Acetaminophen for suitable pain/fever; saline nasal support. Antiviral options depend on diagnosis, risk and timing.
responses.equipment_dependencies: Thermometer, oral syringes, fluid/feeding support, ventilation and age-appropriate infection precautions.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.prevention_recognition: Reduce allergen/insect contact; distinguish itching from airway symptoms or painful/vision-changing eyes.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: Loratadine for suitable allergy symptoms; hydrocortisone 1% for eligible limited dermatitis; lubricating drops for simple dryness.
responses.equipment_dependencies: Correct adult/child formulations, intact skin assessment, exposure control and clean eye products.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.prevention_recognition: Safe food/water and hygiene; track intake, urine, alertness, blood in stool and worsening pain.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: ORS/fluid replacement; ondansetron where clinically appropriate; loperamide only for eligible adult watery diarrhea. Cause-directed treatment when indicated.
responses.equipment_dependencies: Exact ORS mixing volume, potable water, clean cups, dosing devices, feeding continuation and infant assessment.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.prevention_recognition: Clean wounds early and reassess; spreading redness, pus, systemic illness or rapid worsening changes urgency.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: Systemic antibiotics matched to infection; abscess drainage/debridement when required. See antibiotic options below.
responses.equipment_dependencies: Adult/child formulations; wound-cleaning supplies; clinician procedure kit and follow-up; severe-infection resources.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.prevention_recognition: Safer cooking/shade; assess depth, size, location and infant involvement.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: Cool first; suitable superficial burns may use petrolatum/nonstick protection and analgesia. Severe burns follow R37.
responses.equipment_dependencies: Cool clean water, nonstick dressing, shade and temperature protection; cooling precedes topical products.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.prevention_recognition: Eye protection; recognize pain, light sensitivity, persistent grit or changed vision.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: Flush loose surface material; clinician examination for abrasion/retained material. Penetrating injury requires protection without pressure.
responses.equipment_dependencies: Accessible irrigation, eye shield and ophthalmic assessment; drops do not resolve retained/penetrating objects.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.prevention_recognition: Keep skin/footwear dry; assess distribution and distinguish bacterial rash or eczema.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: Clotrimazole 1% for an appropriate localized fungal infection; site/age-specific alternatives if needed.
responses.equipment_dependencies: Dry socks, clean clothing and washing/drying resources; no automatic steroid treatment of fungal rash.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.prevention_recognition: Recognize painful urination; fever, flank pain, vomiting or systemic illness changes treatment needs.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: Site-specific antibiotic selection. Nitrofurantoin is a lower-UTI option, not a kidney-infection/sepsis substitute.
responses.equipment_dependencies: Urine assessment/culture access when indicated, hydration, renal-function/pregnancy/lactation review and escalation resources.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.problem: Dental pain, broken tooth/filling and abscess
responses.prevention_recognition: Oral hygiene; recognize swelling, fever, swallowing difficulty or spreading infection.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: Analgesia plus definitive dental treatment/drainage. Antibiotics when clinically indicated; pain alone does not establish that need.
responses.equipment_dependencies: Brush/floss, clean mouth-care water, dentist access and procedure supplies; antibiotics do not repair a tooth.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.prevention_recognition: Recognize pain/fever; examination distinguishes otitis from other causes and complications.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: Pain relief; observation or systemic antibiotic according to diagnosis/severity. Amoxicillin is one candidate for selected bacterial infections.
responses.equipment_dependencies: Otoscope/exam capability, appropriate pediatric formulation and follow-up.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.prevention_recognition: Hand hygiene; painful red eye, light sensitivity, vision change or newborn discharge requires assessment.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: Diagnosis-specific ophthalmic treatment; selected antibacterial eye medicine only when appropriate.
responses.equipment_dependencies: Ophthalmic-labelled products, clean handling and eye/neonatal assessment; skin ointments are not eye medicine.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.problem: Pneumonia, bronchiolitis and significant respiratory infection
responses.prevention_recognition: Recognize increased work of breathing, lethargy or poor feeding; lower exposure where possible.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: Bacterial pneumonia: selected systemic antibiotic. Viral bronchiolitis: supportive care; bronchodilator only for an appropriate clinical indication.
responses.equipment_dependencies: Age-appropriate monitoring, feeding/hydration, oxygen/airway support when needed and access to respiratory care.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.problem: Interrupted prescriptions or damaged medical aids
responses.prevention_recognition: Record exact medicines and storage; detect lost/broken devices or refill shortfall early.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: Continuity of the actual prescription; replacements matched to original medicine/device.
responses.equipment_dependencies: Private medication list, protected reserve, power/cooling if required, accessible duplicate essentials and expiry audit.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.prevention_recognition: Track eating and child growth/feeding; recognize persistent weakness, intolerance or weight loss.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: Food/feeding support first; investigate underlying disease. Specific supplements only when indicated.
responses.equipment_dependencies: Existing food/water/cooking plans, appropriate infant feeding support and growth assessment.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.prevention_recognition: Assess exposure and rash; reduce sharing of bedding/clothes.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: Confirmed infestation needs its specific antiparasitic treatment; infant, pregnancy and lactation eligibility differs.
responses.equipment_dependencies: Laundry/bedding/clothing and contact-treatment plan; species/diagnosis-specific product selection.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.prevention_recognition: Recognize infection plus worsening alertness, breathing, circulation or general condition.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: Prompt appropriate systemic antibiotics and source treatment; IV fluids, oxygen and further support as clinically required.
responses.equipment_dependencies: Parenteral antibiotic/infusion capacity, monitoring, labs/procedure support and a viable advanced-care route.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.problem: Severe dehydration, electrolyte disturbance or acute kidney injury
responses.prevention_recognition: Recognize poor intake/urine, lethargy or impaired circulation; address fluid-loss causes early.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: Clinically guided fluid/electrolyte treatment; IV support for severe illness, additional renal care if required.
responses.equipment_dependencies: IV fluids/access, age-appropriate monitoring, electrolyte/renal tests and advanced care; no generic home electrolyte-correction recipe.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.prevention_recognition: Recognize sudden airway, breathing or circulation problems after possible exposure.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: Epinephrine for anaphylaxis, plus emergency assessment/support. Oral antihistamines do not replace it.
responses.equipment_dependencies: Patient-compatible epinephrine device/formulation, repeat-treatment availability and airway/oxygen support.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.problem: Appendicitis, obstruction or other surgical abdomen
responses.prevention_recognition: Recognize severe/progressive pain, persistent vomiting, distension or concerning examination.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: Cause-specific treatment and surgery when needed; symptom relief does not resolve obstruction/appendicitis.
responses.equipment_dependencies: Examination, imaging, fluids and surgical/transport capability.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.problem: Heart attack, stroke, arrhythmia or seizure
responses.prevention_recognition: Recognize acute chest/neurologic symptoms or prolonged seizure; rapid assessment determines treatment.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: Condition-specific emergency protocol; medicines for cardiac, stroke and seizure problems are not interchangeable.
responses.equipment_dependencies: CPR/AED capability, cardiac/glucose assessment, age-appropriate resuscitation and time-sensitive advanced care.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.problem: GI bleeding or severe invasive diarrhea
responses.prevention_recognition: Recognize blood/black stool, faintness, severe pain or systemic illness.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: Cause-directed treatment, fluids and bleeding support; antibiotics for selected infection. Adult antidiarrheals may be inappropriate.
responses.equipment_dependencies: Circulation monitoring, labs and potential endoscopy/transfusion/advanced-care access.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.problem: Tetanus risk or relevant animal-bite exposure
responses.prevention_recognition: Keep vaccine records; assess contaminated wounds and animal/exposure history.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: Exposure-specific tetanus vaccine/immune globulin or rabies prevention; selected bite antibiotics.
responses.equipment_dependencies: Wound care, records and actual vaccine/immune-globulin cold-chain/clinical access. Antibiotics do not replace these prophylaxes.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.problem: Suicidal crisis, psychiatric deterioration or relevant withdrawal
responses.prevention_recognition: Recognize immediate danger or severe behavioral change; withdrawal applies only to relevant dependence.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: Crisis care and diagnosis-specific clinician treatment; supervised withdrawal treatment may require monitoring.
responses.equipment_dependencies: Continuous support/safe environment, confidential history, communication and appropriate crisis/clinical resources.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.prevention_recognition: Avoid unstable structures; assess deformity, circulation and open injury.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: Analgesia, stabilization and definitive treatment; open fractures may need early systemic antibiotics and surgery.
responses.equipment_dependencies: Splints, wound coverage, clinician examination/imaging and orthopedic/transport capability.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.prevention_recognition: Recognize entrapment, severe swelling or neurovascular changes; coordinate rescue and medical care.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: Clinician-led resuscitation, surgical assessment and treatment of renal/electrolyte complications.
responses.equipment_dependencies: Rescue coordination, IV/monitoring resources, surgical access and possible renal support.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.prevention_recognition: Prevent falls/impacts; recognize altered consciousness, focal weakness or severe trauma.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: Trauma assessment and cause-specific treatment; limit unnecessary movement with suspected spinal injury.
responses.equipment_dependencies: Airway/monitoring, careful evacuation, imaging and trauma/surgical facilities.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.prevention_recognition: Recognize uncontrolled bleeding and impaired circulation; injury prevention and early assessment.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: Existing bleeding-control capability plus resuscitation/definitive trauma treatment as required.
responses.equipment_dependencies: Existing trauma bag, protective gloves, transport and potential IV/blood/surgery resources; supply audit deferred.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.problem: Major burn, smoke inhalation or airway injury
responses.prevention_recognition: Safer fuel use/escape; assess burn extent and breathing injury.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: Cooling/analgesia, airway care, clinically selected fluids and burn treatment. Cream alone provides little coverage.
responses.equipment_dependencies: Clean cooling water, protective coverage, oxygen/airway capability and burn/trauma access.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.prevention_recognition: Reduce smoke exposure; distinguish irritation from worsening breathing.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: Albuterol for clinically appropriate bronchospasm; additional respiratory support if needed. It does not remove smoke exposure.
responses.equipment_dependencies: Protected clean air; compatible aerosol inhaler/chamber/mask if selected; nebulizer alternative needs power and correct formulation.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.prevention_recognition: Limit heat/exertion; recognize weakness or confusion in hot conditions.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: Prompt cooling and appropriate fluid care; fever medicines do not treat environmental heat stroke.
responses.equipment_dependencies: Shade/cooler location, clean water/cooling materials, temperature assessment and emergency transport.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.prevention_recognition: Dry shelter/clothing; recognize cold exposure, lethargy or altered function.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: Warming and clinical resuscitation if severe; medication is not the primary prevention.
responses.equipment_dependencies: Dry layers/blankets, shelter, safe heat and age-appropriate temperature monitoring.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.prevention_recognition: Safe outdoor combustion and functioning alarms; consider CO with shared headache/nausea.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: End exposure safely; emergency oxygen/assessment and further treatment as indicated.
responses.equipment_dependencies: Battery-backed CO alarms, safe fuel practices, oxygen/transport capability.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.problem: Chemical poisoning or chemical eye/skin injury
responses.prevention_recognition: Separate chemicals and use protection; identify exposure without delaying decontamination.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: Exposure-specific decontamination/poison treatment; chemical eye exposure requires immediate prolonged flushing.
responses.equipment_dependencies: Product information, poison contacts, accessible clean irrigation and clinical support; no general-purpose antidote.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.prevention_recognition: Avoid live damaged equipment, wires and electricity near water.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: Safe scene first; CPR/AED when indicated, cardiac/burn/trauma treatment.
responses.equipment_dependencies: Isolation of power by appropriate personnel, lighting, AED/medical assessment and transport.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.prevention_recognition: Protect water access and avoid hazardous rescue; recognize breathing problems after exposure.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: Safe rescue, breathing support/CPR and assessment; infection treatment only when clinically indicated.
responses.equipment_dependencies: Rescue safety, age-appropriate resuscitation, oxygen and advanced care.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.problem: Overdose, toxic ingestion, choking or dangerous swallowed object
responses.prevention_recognition: Locked medicines/chemicals and caregiver dose log; identify airway obstruction or ingestion promptly.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: Age-appropriate choking/CPR response, poison advice and object/toxin-specific treatment; do not induce vomiting.
responses.equipment_dependencies: Locks, labelled packaging, dosing tools/log, poison information and possible airway/endoscopy resources.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.prevention_recognition: Safer location and support; recognize injury and urgent exposure concerns.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: Trauma care plus time-sensitive exposure-specific prophylaxis and confidential support.
responses.equipment_dependencies: Safe location, clinical/forensic access, relevant prophylaxis and communication.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.problem: Feeding problems and interrupted neonatal care
responses.prevention_recognition: Support feeding continuity; track intake/output and follow-up; recognize lethargy or inadequate feeding.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: Feeding/lactation support; clinically selected supplemental feeding if required; fluid/glucose treatment for serious deficits.
responses.equipment_dependencies: Appropriate feeds, hygiene and clinician assessment; neonatal monitoring/IV support if needed. A manual-expression option reduces power dependence.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.prevention_recognition: Arrange early follow-up; recognize worsening jaundice, poor feeding or unusual sleepiness.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: Feeding assessment and bilirubin-guided phototherapy when indicated; sunlight is not a substitute for a clinical treatment plan.
responses.equipment_dependencies: Weight/bilirubin assessment, feeding support and real phototherapy/power resources when prescribed.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.prevention_recognition: Recognize fever or abnormal temperature, reduced feeding/movement or breathing change.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: Urgent neonatal assessment and appropriate parenteral antimicrobials/support when indicated. Adult oral antibiotics do not define neonatal coverage.
responses.equipment_dependencies: Neonatal dosing/IV capability, cultures/testing, temperature/airway support and accessible neonatal care.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.prevention_recognition: Back sleeping on a firm flat clear surface; recognize breathing/temperature instability.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: Cause-specific neonatal care; safe sleep and environmental temperature control prevent exposure harm.
responses.equipment_dependencies: Safe cot/bassinet, light clothing/warmth as appropriate, clean air and neonatal resuscitation resources.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.prevention_recognition: Maintain hygiene and bowel support; distinguish expected recovery from heavy bleeding or fever.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: Appropriate acetaminophen/ibuprofen and bowel treatment; reassess persistent/worsening symptoms.
responses.equipment_dependencies: Pads, clean water, toilet/privacy and existing prescribed recovery medicines.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.problem: Nipple injury, engorgement, mastitis or breast abscess
responses.prevention_recognition: Support latch/feeding; recognize worsening focal pain, fever or persistent symptoms.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: Continue appropriate feeding/hand expression, gentle support and analgesia; antibiotic/drainage for indicated bacterial disease/abscess.
responses.equipment_dependencies: Lactation support, clean cold compress and feeding supplies; clinician examination/procedure resources.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.prevention_recognition: Clean recovery care; recognize fever, tenderness, wound changes or systemic illness.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: Site-specific systemic antibiotics and source treatment where indicated; uterine/systemic infection may need advanced care.
responses.equipment_dependencies: Appropriate examination, adult/lactation formulation, hygiene and parenteral/procedure capability if needed.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.prevention_recognition: Recognize heavy blood loss, severe headache/vision change, calf swelling or chest/breathing symptoms.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: Cause-specific obstetric/emergency treatment: hemorrhage drugs, antihypertensive/anticonvulsant or anticoagulation only for the diagnosed problem.
responses.equipment_dependencies: BP/circulation assessment; obstetric, IV/blood/surgical or thromboembolism resources. Trauma bandages do not provide complete coverage.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

responses.prevention_recognition: Caregiver support; recognize inability to function, self-harm thoughts or psychotic symptoms.
responses.medicine_treatment_options: Mental-health treatment; psychosis/safety concerns require urgent clinical support.
responses.equipment_dependencies: Caregiver backup, safe environment and perinatal mental-health/crisis access.
responses.status: RESEARCHER PROPOSAL; patient-specific selection and quantities pending

antibiotic_candidates.name: Cephalexin
antibiotic_candidates.limits: Does not give dependable MRSA coverage; abscesses can require drainage. Adult/child formulation and renal review.

antibiotic_candidates.name: Amoxicillin/clavulanate
antibiotic_candidates.role: Selected infected animal/human bites and other appropriate mixed aerobic/anaerobic infections.
antibiotic_candidates.limits: Specific contaminated-wound exposure may need different agents. Liquid refrigeration and short after-mixing life matter.

antibiotic_candidates.name: Amoxicillin
antibiotic_candidates.role: Selected bacterial ear/respiratory infections when diagnosis/susceptibility supports it.
antibiotic_candidates.limits: Viral illness and severe pneumonia need different responses. It is not interchangeable with amoxicillin/clavulanate.

antibiotic_candidates.name: MRSA-active option, selected by the doctors
antibiotic_candidates.role: For relevant purulent infection/resistant-organism scenarios; TMP-SMX is one guideline-listed candidate.
antibiotic_candidates.limits: Other required organism coverage, source control, age, kidney function and pregnancy/lactation determine selection. No newborn formulation inferred.

antibiotic_candidates.name: Lower-UTI option, such as nitrofurantoin if appropriate
antibiotic_candidates.role: Selected lower urinary infection after patient/renal/feeding assessment.
antibiotic_candidates.limits: Fever/flank pain or systemic illness requires a kidney-infection/sepsis plan; nitrofurantoin is not that replacement.

antibiotic_candidates.name: Separate parenteral formulary
antibiotic_candidates.role: Severe infection, open-fracture care or neonatal infection, according to the clinical situation.
antibiotic_candidates.limits: Appropriate agents plus access/infusion supplies, monitoring, diagnostics and source-control capability; neonatal and adult choices differ.

priorities.candidates: ORS, safe mixing water and immediately usable suitable fluids; clinically selected ondansetron where useful to restore drinking.
priorities.rationale: Fluid loss can become fatal; infant feeding and formulation are separate requirements.

priorities.candidates: Selected oral antibiotic formulary with adult/child dispensing plan; parenteral infection-treatment resources where severe/neonatal disease requires them.
priorities.rationale: High consequence of unavailable effective treatment; route and source control determine real coverage.

priorities.candidates: Patient-compatible epinephrine; albuterol inhalation setup for clinically appropriate bronchospasm.
priorities.rationale: Rare but time-critical; identify usable formulation/device and clinical indications.

priorities.candidates: Adult/child acetaminophen; suitable ibuprofen option; thermometers, mL-marked dosing devices and dose log.
priorities.rationale: Common needs, preserved function and recognition of illness; no newborn fever-reducer pathway inferred.

priorities.candidates: Safe cleaning/irrigation water, soap, gloves, nonstick coverage and plain petrolatum; eye shield/irrigation.
priorities.rationale: Prevents deterioration and vision-threatening delay. Check existing bag before duplicating supplies.

priorities.module: Essential monitoring, newborn and recovery needs
priorities.candidates: Private prescription continuity; feeding/safe sleep, pads/hygiene, temperature assessment and needed clinical monitoring.
priorities.rationale: Preserves essential care when utilities and access fail; supplies must match actual patients.

priorities.candidates: Lighting, CO detection, safe shelter/cooling/clean air; accessible resuscitation, oxygen/IV/procedure/transport resources for indicated emergencies.
priorities.rationale: Medication alone leaves major failure modes uncovered. Bleeding-kit audit remains deferred.

priorities.module: Time-sensitive exposure prevention and crisis care
priorities.candidates: Actual tetanus/rabies prevention access, clinician-selected post-assault prophylaxis and urgent psychiatric/perinatal crisis resources.
priorities.rationale: Delay can cause preventable severe harm; clinical resources and cold chain are supply/access requirements.

priorities.candidates: Loratadine; suitable PEG 3350; hydrocortisone 1%; clotrimazole 1%; zinc-oxide barrier; nasal saline; lubricating eye drops.
priorities.rationale: Useful frequent-illness coverage; avoid overlap and age/site-inappropriate products.

priorities.candidates: Loperamide for appropriate short-term adult watery diarrhea.
priorities.rationale: Functional benefit; hydration/source treatment carries the larger consequence of shortage.

priorities.candidates: Clinician-selected ophthalmic antibiotic, infestation treatment or temporary dental-care items if relevant to expected scenarios.
priorities.rationale: Match diagnosis and patient; these need different resources from generalized infection treatment.

priorities.candidates: Additional clean skin/diaper/foot-care supplies, manual feeding support, oral hygiene and mental-health support resources.
priorities.rationale: Reduces accumulating problems over weeks; broad function matters without assuming every product is necessary.

priorities.candidates: Adult meclizine for motion sickness; famotidine for acid symptoms; second laxative if useful; allergy eye drops.
priorities.rationale: Choose for demonstrated usefulness after shared essential functions are covered.

priorities.candidates: Suitable minor-wound topical product such as bacitracin/polymyxin B if selected.
priorities.rationale: Localized optional role; systemic infection treatment remains P1, and routine clean-cut/burn use is not the default.

priorities.candidates: Bismuth, additional duplicate symptom products or broad supplements only if a defined role remains.
priorities.rationale: Breastfeeding/child restrictions and duplication can limit value; no automatic broad supplement purchase.

next_step: deduplicate against confirmed owned supplies, select licensed-pharmacy formulation/course counts and inspect current retail listings/expiry/price without purchasing
